czech: Já už jsem odešel, když zavolala?
english: Had I already left when she called?

czech: Ty jsi skončil, než začalo pršet?
english: Had you finished before it started raining?

czech: On už jedl, když jsme dorazili?
english: Had he eaten by the time we arrived?
Had she arrived before the meeting started?

czech: To se rozbilo, než jsme to zkontrolovali?
english: Had it broken before we checked it?

czech: My jsme už zapomněli heslo, když jsme ho potřebovali?
english: Had we already forgotten the password when we needed it?

czech: Vy jste ten film viděli před naším setkáním?
english: Had you seen the movie before our meeting?

czech: Oni už odešli, když jsme dorazili?
english: Had they already left when we arrived?
